introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content1: My name is Sebastian. I'm 26 years old. I believe in taking care of myself and a balanced diet and rigorous exercise routine. I graduated from the Universidad Autónoma de San Luis Potosí, with a degree in Computer Science. I currently have three years of experience in web development.
introduction.content2: My work has led me to focus on full stack development. I have a particular passion for front end (I also enjoy back end!). I'm motivated by creating solutions that make an impact, while staying open to opportunities for growth and innovation.

hobbies.title: Hobbies & Lifestyle
hobbies.content: Outside of work, I have several hobbies, with gym and gaming being the ones I enjoy the most. I consider myself to live an active life.

ai.title: What I Think About AI
ai.content: I believe AI is a powerful tool that it will never replace human creativity and problem solving. We can use it to automate repetitive tasks. As long as we use it responsibly, it can be a great tool.
